body.title: Unit + contract test suites
body.summary: Add node:test (tsx --test) + node:assert/strict suites under vscode-plugin/src/chat/__tests__/: a unit suite over renderTerminalStyle/surfaceClass/terminalTheme (postconditions, guards, determinism, light-variant, totality) and a contract suite (mock round-trip byte-equality, five-surface coverage, vscode-free + no-remote-origin source scans, anti-chat-bubble scan). Run the scoped src/chat suite first, then tsc + the full plugin sweep as the regression gate.
acceptanceChecks: Unit suite proves every renderTerminalStyle postcondition + both guards + determinism + the light-theme variant + surfaceClass totality + terminalTheme frozenness.

Contract suite proves the mock round-trip byte-equality for all five surfaces, exactly-five-surface coverage, the vscode-free + no-remote-origin/asWebviewUri source scans, and the anti-chat-bubble scan (mapping ac1 + ac2).
npx tsc --noEmit clean; the scoped src/chat/__tests__ suite passes, and the full vscode-plugin test sweep passes with no regressions.

tests.name: design-tokens unit suite authored under src/chat/__tests__/ (all renderer/surfaceClass/terminalTheme cases green)
design-tokens contract suite authored (mock round-trip + coverage + vscode-free/no-remote-origin scans + anti-chat-bubble)
full vscode-plugin tsc + test sweep passes with no regressions
